notes.title: Paplion Update 0.1.3
notes.notes:
Changelog:

[list]
[*] Fixed the deadly Papling swaping bug. Now it can't happen having only defeated Papling in your hand resulting in crashing when entering a combat.
[*] Fixed input links with the overworld abilities boxes. No more confusion.
[*] Added new minigame type for some abilities.
[*] Now the element type of the ability can be seen in the abilities ready for combat section both in the deck menu and the battle data panels.
[*] Added feedback button in the main menu which opens a form to give some feedback and a link to another form for bug reporting.
[*] Now the player can't reach Salt Lake through Foam Forest after rejecting Pripe's request until the fallen human in Frozen Grotto is met.
[*] Some tweaks on some elements of the battle UI
[/list]

notes.title: Update 0.1.2
notes.notes:
New update with some improvements in the early game to allow better clarity in understanding some mechanics.


[list]
[*]Hidden Hand UI until befriended the first Papling. This will prevent some players to get confused about the empty UI.
[*]Now, upon befriending a Papling, if the player has empty Overworld Ability slots, the new Papling will be selected for that slot automatically. This will help players realize the OW Abilities mechanic in the tutorial.
[*]The falling elements minigame of some abilities now has a visual indicator for the limit of the falling elements and will give feedback when they hit it instead of just falling through the UI.
[*]Fixed bug where the wishlist button in the main menu could be interactable in cases where it shouldn't.
[*]Save menu text better alignment.
[/list]

notes.title: Demo available NOW!
notes.notes:
Paplion Demo is here!!!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3485820/Paplion_Demo/

You will have access to a fair amount of content as you will play until you get the first of the six crystals, that means you will beat the entire first chapter. You will have only access to the cerulean world to get the blue crystal. The cerulean world has two different paths you can take, so the final boss of that world will be different depending on which path you take, so the experience can be different of other people, or if you replay it.

I hope everyone who plays enjoys the game. Feedback and bug reports would be really helpful as a solodev, so if you have any issue or comment, be free to post it!
